test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2'** i.e. **'Which'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2 is: **'which'.**
 
• The reason **'which'** is correct in this context is because it is referring to 'England,' a non-living thing.
 
• When referring to non-living things or animals, 'which' is the appropriate relative pronoun to use.
 
• In the sentence "one of the most distinguished novelists which England has produced," **'which'** is used to relate the production of the novelists to England.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **who:** This is used as a relative pronoun for people, not countries.
 
• **what: **This is not a suitable relative pronoun in this context.
 
• **whose:** This is a possessive form of 'who' and is used to indicate ownership or relationship. It is not suitable in this context.
